incidents.name: Unwarp unwrapWETH pays out more than it receives
incidents.notes: unwrapWETH(uint256,address) released the caller-supplied amount of ether to the caller-supplied recipient without checking it against what the caller had actually deposited, so a flash-loaned 100.85 WETH transfer was redeemed for 104.83 ETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: proxy 0x8bEfC1d90d03011a7d0b35B3a00eC50f8E014802 created 2025-04-25T08:02:09Z by 0x29eb782b8707227fac7620ee7b3ab8c6a34f074b, not the attack-tx sender 0x5cc162c556092fe1d993b95d1b9e9ce58a11dbc9; four EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last at block 29865499 on 2025-05-06T08:32:25Z installing 0xd971fd39d9714d5eb1b54b931790170a0630f131, so the executing code was 7.98 days old. The PoC transfers 100.852657473363426325 WETH in and calls unwrapWETH for 104.833984375 ETH out. Reported loss ~9k USDT.
